spanish: Y hizo al altar un enrejado, obra de red de bronce, debajo de su borde desde abajo hasta su mitad.
grammarChanges: Inserted the indefinite article 'un' before 'enrejado' so it reads as the noun object (the grating) made for the altar, not as an adjective describing the altar.
readerNote: Added 'un' before enrejado to mark it as the noun object made for the altar rather than an adjective on altar.
